The garden of ancient olive trees, with: Ibala lya miolivi ya kale, pamo ne Basilika ya Nko Shonse iyakuulwa pa mulu wa libwe apo Shikulu wesu apepele ali mu bulanda bukalamba.
Saint Peter in Gallicantu, Mount Zion: Santu Petro mu Gallicantu, Mupili wa Sioni
The Church of Saint Peter in Gallicantu: Icalici ca Santu Petro mu Gallicantu («ilyo mukolwe alilile») cibukisha ukukaana kwa kwa Petro no bushiku ubo Shikulu wesu alaala mu cifungo. Bambi babika ing'anda ya shimapepo mukalamba mupepi na Cenacolo.
Church of the Flagellation and Ecce Homo: Icalici ca Kupumwa ne Cikuulwa ca Ecce Homo, Via Dolorosa
The Way of the Cross begins at the Anton: Inshila ya Musalaba itampila pe Linga lya Antonia, uko Bafransiskani basunga amacalici ya Kupumwa na ya Kupingulwa. Abasambilila abengi babika Pilato mu ng'anda ya bufumu iya kwa Herode mupepi ne Cipata ca Yafa.
The Way of the Cross, Old City of Jerusa: Inshila ya Musalaba, Umusumba wa Kale uwa Yerusalemu
Since the Middle Ages pilgrims have pray: Ukutula mu Nshita sha pa Kati, abapempelo bapepa Incende sha Nshila ya Musalaba muli uyu musebo, ukutula pe Linga lya Antonia ukufika ku Kalvari; cila Cisano Bafransiskani batungulula ulwendo. Inshila ya cine iyo Shikulu wesu apitilemo yalingana na uko Pilato amupingwile.
Church of the Holy Sepulchre, Jerusalem: Basilika ya Nshiinda ya Mushilo, Yerusalemu
Christians have honoured this place sinc: Abena Kristu bacindika iyi ncende ukutula ku nkulo sha kubalilapo; Santu Helena na Konstantino bakuulile basilika pa mulu we libwe lya Kalvari ne nshiinda iyabula cintu, kabili nomba Bafransiskani e babombelamo.
Luke gives the distance as about seven m: Luka alanda ubutali bwa sitadia amakumi mutanda ukufuma ku Yerusalemu (Luke 24:13). Incende shitatu shicindikwa: Emmaus Nicopolis, iilangilwe pano; El-Qubeibeh, iisungwa na Bafransiskani; na Abu Ghosh.
Church of the Primacy of Saint Peter, Ta: Icalici ca Bukulu bwa Santu Petro, Tabgha
A small basalt church on the water's edg: Icalici icinono ica mabwe yafiita mu mbali ya menshi, icakuulwa ukushinguluka ilibwe ilyo beta «Mensa Christi» (Itebulo lya Kristu), apo, ukulingana ne ntambi, aipikile Abatumwa ica kulya ca lucelo.
Church of the Sepulchre of Saint Mary, K: Icalici ca Nshiinda ya Maria, umupokapoka wa Kedroni
Since at least the fifth century the Chu: Ukutula mu myanda ya myaka iya busano nangu kale, Ekeleshia ya ku Yerusalemu icindika iyi nshiinda pe samba lya Mupili wa Olivi, mupepi na Getsemane, nge ncende umo Nyina wa Lesa asendelwe ku muulu. Ing'anda ya bamonaki iya Kusendama pa mupili wa Sioni yibukisha ukusendama kwakwe; intambi shimbi shitila imyaka yakwe iya kulekelesha aikele na Santu Yohane ku Efeso.
Chapel of the Ascension, Mount of Olives: Akacalici ka Kuninina ku Muulu, Mupili wa Olivi
Luke says He led them \"as far as Bethan: Luka atila abatwele «ukufika ku Betania» (Luke 24:50), lelo Imilimo ya Batumwa yatila babwelele ukufuma pa Mupili wa Olivi (Acts 1:12). Akacalici akanono pa mulu kasunga ilibwe ilicindikwa ngo lyakwata ulukasa lwakwe ulwa kulekelesha.
The angel Gabriel greets the Virgin Mary: Malaika Gabrieli aposha Nacisungu uwaisulamo ukusenamina. Ilyo ayasuka ati «cibe kuli ine ifyo walanda», Icebo cisanguka umuntu mu nda yakwe.
Mary carries Our Lord to her kinswoman E: Maria asenda Shikulu wesu ku kwa ndupwa yakwe Elisabeti. Yohane acilauka mu nda ku nsansa, Elisabeti amwita «Nyina wa Shikulu wandi», kabili Maria aimba Magnificat.
Our Lord is born of the Virgin Mary in t: Mu musumba wa kwa Davidi, Shikulu wesu afyalwa kuli Maria Nacisungu, apombwa mu fya kufwala kabili alaalikwa mu cilyelo ca nama, pantu tabasangile incende mu ng'anda ya beni.
An angel announces \"a savior who is Mes: Malaika abila «Umupusushi, uwaba Kristu Shikulu», kabili ibumba lya ku muulu liimba ati «Ubukata kuli Lesa ku muulu». Bacemi bendesha ukuya ukufwaya Umwana.
Wise men from the East follow His star,: Abalumbuka ukufuma ku kabanga bakonka ulutanda lwakwe, basanga Umwana na Maria nyina, kabili bamupeela golde, ubwanga bwa kununshya na mure.
Mary and Joseph present the Child to the: Maria na Yosefe batuula Shikulu Umwana. Simeoni amusenda mu maboko yakwe, amwita «ulubuuto ulwa kulabuushako inko», kabili aeba Maria ukuti ulupanga lukatuula umutima wakwe.
Warned in a dream, Saint Joseph rises by: Ilyo asokwa mu ciloto, Santu Yosefe abuka ubushiku no kusenda Umwana na nyina ku Egupti, ukutali ne kuboko kwa kwa Herode, pa kuti cifikilishiwe icebo ca kuti: «Naitile umwana wandi ukufuma mu Egupti» (Hosea 11:1).
After Herod's death the Holy Family sett: Ilyo Herode afwa, Ulupwa lwa Mushilo lwikala mu Nazarete, kabili «umwana alekula, alekosa, aisulamo amano, kabili ukusenamina kwa kwa Lesa kwali pali wene».
At twelve He stays behind in Jerusalem a: Ali ne myaka ikumi na ibili, ashala mu Yerusalemu pa numa ya Pasaka. Pa bushiku bwa butatu, Maria na Yosefe bamusanga pa kati ka bakasambilisha: «Bushe tamwaishibe ukuti ndi no kuba mu fya kwa Tata?»
For some thirty years He lives at Nazare: Pa myaka nalimo amakumi yatatu aikala mu Nazarete, aleumfwila Maria na Yosefe, alebomba umulimo wa bukafundi wa mapulanga, kabili alekula mu mano, mu butali na mu kusenamina pa menso ya kwa Lesa na bantu.
John baptizes Him in the Jordan. The hea: Yohane amubatisha muli Yordani. Umuulu waisuka, Mupashi wa Mushilo aika nge nkunda, kabili ishiwi lya kwa Tata litila: «Uyu e Mwana wandi uwatemwikwa, uo nsekelamo sana.»
The Baptism of Christ in the Jordan: Ulubatisho lwa kwa Yesu muli Yordani
Led by the Spirit into the desert, He fa: Mupashi amutwala mu cinkupiti, uko alekesha ukulya inshiku amakumi yane na mashiku amakumi yane, kabili acimfya ukwesha kwa kwa Satana ku Cebo ca kwa Lesa.
John points Him out: \"Behold, the Lamb: Yohane amulanga ati: «Moneni Mwana wa Mpaanga uwa kwa Lesa.» Andrea aleta munyina Simoni, uo Yesu ainika Kefa, ukuti Petro; Filipi na Natanaele bamukonka.
At His mother's word, \"Do whatever he t: Ku cebo ca kwa Nyina, «Cili conse ico engeba, citeni», asandula amenshi ukuba umwangashi, icishibilo cakwe ica kubalilapo, kabili abasambi bakwe batampa ukumutetekela.
The Wedding Feast at Cana: Yesu aiyebekesha pa bwinga bwa ku Kana
To Jesus through Mary: Ukufika kuli Yesu ukupitila muli Maria
The First Passover: Zeal for His Father': Pasaka wa kubalilapo: ukupimpa pa ng'anda ya kwa Tata
He drives the money changers from the Te: Atamfya abakwe ndalama mu Tempele kabili ubushiku asambilisha Nikodemo ukuti umuntu afwile ukufyalwa na kabili ku menshi na ku Mupashi. «Pantu Lesa atemwike icalo ica kuti apeele Umwana wakwe umo rukoso.»
Weary at noon, He asks a Samaritan woman: Ilyo anakile akasuba kaba pa mulu, alomba umwanakashi umusamaria amenshi ya kunwa, kabili amupeela amenshi ya mweo, «umufukumuko wa menshi ayalefukumuka ukufika ku mweo wa muyayaya». Abengi aba mu musumba wakwe bacetekela.
Healing the Official's Son: Ukuposha umwana wa kapitao wa mfumu
A royal official from Capernaum begs Him: Kapitao wa mfumu ukufuma ku Kapernaumu amupaapata ukuti eise. «Kabiye, umwana obe ali no mweo.» Muli iyo nsa ine umwana apola.
In the synagogue He reads Isaiah, \"The: Mu sunagoge abelenga mwi buuku lya kwa Esaya, «Mupashi wa kwa Shikulu uli pali ine», no kutila: «Lelo ici calembwa cafikilishiwa.» Abena mwabo bamutwala ku mpili ya mupili, lelo apita pa kati kabo no kuya.
The Franciscans honour the Mount of the: Bafransiskani bacindika Mupili wa Kupontoka ku kapinda ka ku kulyo aka musumba nge mupili ulandwapo muli Luke 4:29.
Leaving Nazareth, He makes His home in C: Ilyo afuma ku Nazarete, aikala ku Kapernaumu mu mbali ya bemba, kabili atampa ukushimikila: «Inshita yafika, Ubufumu bwa kwa Lesa bwapalama. Lapileni kabili cetekeleni Landwe Lusuma.»
By the shore He calls Simon and Andrew,: Mu mbali ya bemba aita Simoni na Andrea, Yakobo na Yohane: «Nkonkeni, nkamulenga ukuba abaipaya ba bantu.» Pa numa ya kwipaya isabi mu cipesha amano, basha fyonse no kumukonka.
He teaches with authority in the synagog: Asambilisha na maka mu sunagoge, atamfya umupashi uubi mu muntu, abusha nafyala wa kwa Petro ku mpepo, kabili ilyo akasuba kawa umusumba onse ulongana pa mwinshi.
The Paralytic and the Call of Matthew: Uwafwa umubili ne ciito ca kwa Mateo
Friends lower a paralyzed man through th: Abanankwe bakonteshya uwafwa umubili ukupitila pa mutenge; Yesu amubelelela imembu no kumweba ukwenda. Pa numa aita Levi, Mateo, apa kusonkeshya imisonko: «Nkonke.»
He teaches the Beatitudes, \"Blessed are: Asambilisha Amapaalo, «Bapaalwa abapiina mu mupashi, pantu Ubufumu bwa mu muulu bwabo», ifunde ipya ilya kutemwa, ne pepo lya Tata Wesu.
A Roman centurion says, \"Lord, I am not: Kalamba wa basilikali umuRoma atila: «Shikulu, nshayelele ukuti mwingile mu ng'anda yandi, lelo landeni fye icebo.» Ekeleshia ibwekeshapo amashiwi yakwe ilyo taipokelele Ukupokelela mu Misa iili yonse.
Moved with pity for a widow burying her: Alanguluka umukamfwilwa uwali ukushiika umwana wakwe umo rukoso, akumya pa cisendelo: «Mulumendo, ndekweba, ima!» kabili amubwesesha kuli nyina.
At a feast in Jerusalem He heals a man i: Pa mutebeto mu Yerusalemu aposha umuntu uwalwele imyaka amakumi yatatu na cinekonsekonse: «Ima, senda ubusanshi bobe, wende.»
A violent squall swamps the boat while H: Umwela wa mpuupu waisusha ubwato amenshi, ilyo wene alelaala. Akalipila umwela: «Talala! Tontola!» kabili kwaba ukutalala kukalamba. «Ni ani uyu, ukuti umwela na bemba fyamumfwila?»
On the far shore He frees a man tormente: Ku lulamba lumbi aposha umuntu uwalecushiwa ne mipashi iibi iingi, iitumwa mu citanga ca nkumba. Umuntu amupaapata ukuti amukonke, lelo atumwa ukubila ifyo Shikulu amucitile.
A woman is healed by touching His cloak,: Umwanakashi apola ilyo akumya ku cakufwala cakwe, kabili aikata ukuboko kwa mwana umwanakashi uwa kwa Yairo uwafwile: «Talita kumi», ukuti: «Mukashana, ndekweba, ima!»
With five loaves and two fish He feeds t: Ne mikate isano ne sabi shibili alisha ibumba, alolesha ku muulu, atootela no kumokola imikate, kabili balonganika imitanga ikumi na ibili iyaisulamo ifyashalapo.
In the fourth watch of the night He come: Mu nshita ya kulekelesha iya bushiku aisa kuli bena endela pa bemba. Petro enda ukumukumanya, atampa ukubila mu menshi no kupunda ati: «Shikulu, mpusushe!»
In the synagogue at Capernaum He teaches: Mu sunagoge wa ku Kapernaumu asambilisha: «Nine mukate wa mweo… Uulya umubili wandi no kunwa umulopa wandi ali no mweo wa muyayaya.» Petro ayasuka: «Shikulu, tukaya kuli nani?»
A Gentile mother begs Him to heal her da: Banamayo umwina calo cimbi amupaapata pa mulandu wa mwana wakwe umwanakashi: «Na imbwa shilya utufyungwa utuponena pe tebulo lya bashikulu babo.» «Banamayo, ulwitabo lwenu lukalamba!»
Ephphatha, and Four Thousand Fed: Efata, no kulisha abantu amakana yane
He opens the ears of a deaf man, \"Ephph: Aisula amatwi ya muntu uwafwa amatwi, «Efata», ukuti «Isuka!», kabili ne mikate cine-lubali alisha amakana yane abaikele nankwe inshiku shitatu.
Pharisees and Sadducees ask for a sign f: Abafarisi na Basaduki bamulomba icishibilo ukufuma ku muulu. Abeba ukuti tabakapeelwe icishibilo cimbi kano icishibilo ca kwa Yona.
He leads a blind man out of the village: Aikata impofu ku kuboko, aisenda ku nse ya kamushi, kabili aibikapo amaboko imiku ibili, ukufikila yamona fyonse bwino.
\"Who do you say that I am?\" Peter answ: «Lelo imwe mutila ine nine nani?» Petro ayasuka: «Imwe muli Kristu, Umwana wa kwa Lesa wa mweo.» «Iwe uli Petro, kabili pali ili libwe nkakuula Ekeleshia yandi… Nkakupeela imfungulo sha Bufumu bwa mu muulu.»
Before Peter, James and John His face sh: Pa ntanshi ya kwa Petro, Yakobo na Yohane, icinso cakwe calebeka nge kasuba, Mose na Eliya balelanda nankwe, kabili Tata atila: «Uyu e Mwana wandi uwatemwikwa… Mumumfwe.»
He reproaches the towns where most of Hi: Akalipila imisumba umo acitile ifipesha amano fyakwe ifingi, Korazini, Betsaida na Kapernaumu, pantu tayalapile.
Peter finds the Temple tax in the mouth: Petro asanga umusonko wa Tempele mu kanwa ka sabi. Pa numa Yesu aimika umwana pa kati kabo: «Nga tamwaluka no kuba kwati baana abanono, tamwakengile mu Bufumu bwa mu muulu.»
He teaches in the Temple courts, \"Let a: Mu fibansa fya Tempele asambilisha: «Nga umuntu ali ne cilaka, aise kuli ine anwe», abelelela umwanakashi uwaikatwa mu bucende, «Kabiye, kabili ukutula nomba wilacita lubembu na kabili», kabili abila ati: «Nine lubuuto lwa calo.»
He smears clay on the eyes of a man blin: Asubila ilongo ku menso ya muntu uwafyelwe impofu no kumutuma ukusamba mu cishiba ca Siloamu. Abwela alemona kabili amupepa: «Shikulu, ndecetekela.»
Martha welcomes Him while Mary sits at H: Marta amupokelela, lelo Maria aikala ku makasa yakwe alekutika. «Maria asalile icipande icisuma, kabili tacakafumishiwe kuli wene.»
Luke says only \"a village\"; John names: Luka atila fye «mu kamushi kamo»; Yohane alanda Betania nge ng'anda ya kwa Marta na Maria (John 11:1).
When a disciple asks Him to teach them t: Ilyo umo uwa basambi amulomba ukubasambilisha ukupepa, abapeela ipepo lya Tata Wesu.
Luke does not name the place; tradition: Luka talanda incende; intambi shibukisha ifi mu bulindi bwa Eleona pa Mupili wa Olivi. Mateo apeela ili pepo mu Kushimikila pa Mupili (Matthew 6:9-13).
Walking in the portico of Solomon in win: Enda mu cipango ca kwa Solomone mu nshita ya mpepo, no kutila: «Impaanga shandi shiumfwa ishiwi lyandi… Ine na Tata tuli bamo.»
Abwelela ku ncende uko Yohane alebatishisha pa kubalilapo. Asambilisha ukuti ico Lesa alundanya, umuntu ekalekanya, kabili apaala abana: «Lekeni abana abanono baise kuli ine.»
\"I am the resurrection and the life.\": «Nine kubuuka no mweo.» Yesu alila pa nshiinda ya kwa cibusa wakwe, pa numa apunda ne shiwi likalamba: «Lasaro, fuma!» kabili uwafwile afuma acili akakilwe mu fya kufwala.
As the council plots His death, He withd: Ilyo Icilye Cikalamba cilepanga ukumwipaya, afisama na basambi bakwe mu musumba uupalamine icinkupiti uwitwa Efraimu.
Blind Bartimaeus cries, \"Jesus, son of: Impofu Bartimeo ipunda ati: «Yesu, Mwana wa kwa Davidi, nkumbwila uluse!» kabili yamona. Sakeo aninina umuti wa mukuyu pa kuti amumone: «Lelo ubupusushi bwaisa muli iyi ng'anda.»
Six days before Passover, Mary anoints H: Ilyo kwashele inshiku mutanda pa kuti Pasaka afike, Maria asuba amakasa yakwe amafuta ya kununkila aya nardo aya mutengo ukalamba, kabili ing'anda yaisulamo icinunkila. Apokelela ifi ngo kusubwa kwa kushiikwa kwakwe.
He rides into Jerusalem on a colt as the: Engila mu Yerusalemu aninine pa mwana wa punda ilyo ibumba lyanshika ifya kufwala ne misamba: «Hosana kuli Mwana wa kwa Davidi! Apaalwe uwaisa mwi shina lya kwa Shikulu!»
As He comes in sight of the city He weep: Ilyo amona umusumba, aulilila: «Kani na iwe waishibe lelo ifingakuletela umutende!»
He overturns the tables, \"My house shal: Apilibula amatebulo, «Ing'anda yandi ikeetwa ing'anda ya kupepelamo ku nko shonse», kabili alumbanya umukamfwilwa umupiina uwapeele utundalama twakwe tubili utwa kulekelesha.
Seated on the Mount of Olives facing the: Aikele pa Mupili wa Olivi ukulolenkana ne Tempele, alanda pa konaulwa kwalyo na pa kwisa kwakwe mu bukata: «Ico mwacitile umo uwa bamunyinane aba abanono, mwacitile ine.»
He washes His disciples' feet, and takin: Asamba amakasa ya basambi bakwe kabili, ilyo aikata umukate no mwangashi, atila: «Uyu mubili wandi… Iyi nkombo cipangano cipya mu mulopa wandi… Citeni ifi pa kunjibukisha»; e fyo apeela Ekeleshia Ukaristia no bushimapepo.
The Agony in the Garden: Ubulanda bukalamba bwa kwa Yesu mwi bala
He prays in anguish, His sweat like drop: Mu bulanda bukalamba apepa, kabili ulubile lwakwe lwaba nge fitonsho fya mulopa: «Tata… te fyo ine mfwaya, lelo fyo imwe mufwaya.» Yuda aisa ne bumba kabili amushitisha ku kumufyompa.
Before Caiaphas; Peter's Denial: Pa ntanshi ya kwa Kaifa; ukukaana kwa kwa Petro
Bound, He is led before Annas and the hi: Ilyo akakwa, bamutwala kuli Ana na kuli shimapepo mukalamba Kaifa kabili bamupingula pa mulandu wa kusaula Lesa. Mu cibansa, Petro amukaana imiku itatu; mukolwe alila, kabili Petro alila sana.
Pilate finds no guilt in Him and sends H: Pilato tasanga mulandu wa kumupingwila kabili amutuma kuli Herode, uumuseka no kumubwesha. Ibumba lilomba Baraba, kabili Pilato abasuminisha.
The Scourging at the Pillar: Ukupumwa kwa kwa Yesu pa cipanda
\"Then Pilate took Jesus and had him sco: «Pa nshita iyo Pilato asendele Yesu no kumupumisha.» «Ku filonda fyakwe twapoleleko» (Isaiah 53:5).
The soldiers weave a crown of thorns, cl: Abasilikali bapikula icisote ca minga, bamufwika umunkansa uwa bulangeti no kumuseka: «Mutende, Mfumu ya baYuda!» Pilato amufumya: «Moneni umuntu!» kabili amupeela ukuti abambwe.
Carrying the cross Himself, He goes out: Asenda umusalaba wakwe, afuma ukuya ku Kalvari. Simoni wa ku Kurene apatikishiwa ukumwafwa, kabili aeba abanakashi abalelila ati: «Mwe bana banakashi ba ku Yerusalemu, mwilanjilila ine, lelo ililileni mwe bene na bana benu.»
He is crucified between two thieves. \"F: Abambwa pa kati ka bacipondoka babili. «Tata, babelelele, pantu tabaishibe ico balecita.» «Lelo ukaba na ine mu paradiso.» «Mayo, moneni umwana wenu… Mona nyoko.» «Capwa.» Afukama umutwe no kupeela umupashi.
The Crucifixion and Death: Ukubambwa ne mfwa ya kwa Yesu
Joseph of Arimathea and Nicodemus wrap H: Yosefe wa ku Arimatea na Nikodemo bapomba umubili wakwe mu nsalu sha lineni pamo ne fya kununkila, kabili bamubika mu nshiinda ipya iyabaswa mwi libwe, mwi bala mupepi na apo abambilwe.
On the first day of the week the tomb is: Pa bushiku bwa kubalilapo ubwa mulungu, inshiinda iliba ibulamo cintu. Shikulu uwabuukile aita Maria Magdalena pe shina lyakwe kabili amutuma ku Batumwa: «Namona Shikulu.»
He walks unrecognized with two disciples: Ilyo tabamwishibe, enda na basambi babili no kubalondolwela Amalembo, kabili bamwishiba ilyo amokola umukate. «Bushe imitima yesu tayalebilima muli ifwe?»
He stands among the apostles behind lock: Imiinshi yaisalwa, aiminina pa kati ka Batumwa kabili ababuuta umweo: «Pokeleleni Mupashi wa Mushilo. Abo mukabelelela imembu, bakabelelelwa», kabili pa numa ya mulungu umo Tomasi asumina ati: «Shikulu wandi kabili Lesa wandi!»
At dawn by the lake He fills the apostle: Ulucelo pa bemba aisusha amasumbu yabo kabili abapekanishisha ica kulya ca lucelo. Aipusha Petro imiku itatu: «Bushe walintemwa?» kabili imiku itatu amupeela umulimo: «Lisha impaanga shandi.»
On the mountain in Galilee He sends the: Pa mupili mu Galilea atuma Ikumi na Umo: «Kabiyeni, mulenge inko shonse ukuba abasambi, mukabatishe mwi shina lya kwa Tata, na lya Mwana, na lya Mupashi wa Mushilo… Kabili moneni, ndi na imwe inshiku shonse ukufika ku mpela ya calo.»
Matthew does not name the mountain. Pilg: Mateo talanda ishina lya mupili. Abapempelo libili libili baibukisha pa Mupili wa Mapaalo; bambi batontonkanya Tabora nangu mupili wa Arbel.
Forty days after Easter He blesses the a: Inshiku amakumi yane pa numa ya Pasaka apaala Abatumwa, abalaya Mupashi wa Mushilo, kabili asendwa ku muulu ilyo balemona; babwelela ku Yerusalemu ne nsansa ishingi.
Fifty days after Easter, as the apostles: Inshiku amakumi yasano pa numa ya Pasaka, ilyo Abatumwa bali mwi pepo no mutima umo pamo na Maria, Nyina wa kwa Yesu, Mupashi wa Mushilo aika pali bena mu ndimi sha mulilo. Petro ashimikila Kristu uwabambilwe kabili uwabuukile, abantu nalimo amakana yatatu babatishiwa, kabili Ekeleshia iya ku nko shonse.
The Assumption of Our Lady: Ukusendwa ku Muulu kwa Maria Nacisungu
At the end of her earthly life the Immac: Ilyo umweo wakwe pano isonde wapwile, Nyina wa kwa Lesa Uwabula Lubembu lwa Ntanshi, Maria Nacisungu ku muyayaya, asendelwe mu bukata bwa ku muulu umupashi no mubili, nga fintu Papa Pio XII abilishe mu 1950. Uwafyele Shikulu e wa kubalilapo ukwakanamo ukubuuka kwa Mwana wakwe.
Scripture does not record the place. It: Amalembo tayalanda incende. Ilangilwe pa nshiinda uko Ekeleshia ya ku Yerusalemu ukutula kale isefya ukusendwa kwakwe ku muulu.
Her Son crowns the Blessed Virgin Queen: Umwana wakwe afwika Nacisungu uwapaalwa icisote nga Namfumu wa ku muulu ne sonde, Namfumu wa bamalaika na bashila. «Kabili icishibilo cikalamba camoneke mu muulu: umwanakashi uwafwele akasuba, no mweshi pe samba lya makasa yakwe, na pa mutwe wakwe icisote ca ntanda ikumi na shibili.»
This mystery takes place in heaven; it i: Iyi nkama icitikila ku muulu; ilangilwe pano pamo no kusendwa kwakwe ku muulu.
The Coronation of Mary: Ukufwikwa icisote kwa Maria nga Namfumu wa ku muulu ne sonde
Trust in Mary's intercession: Ukushintilila pa kupaapatila kwa kwa Maria
Mondays and Saturdays, and the Sundays o: Palicimo na Pacibelushi, Pepo lya Advent na lya nshita ya Krisimasi
Tuesdays and Fridays, and the Sundays of: Palicibili na Palicisano, Pepo lya Lent
The Rosary grew out of the prayer of the: Rosari yafyelwe mwi pepo lya Ekeleshia. Bamonaki baleimba amalumbo 150, kabili Abena Kristu abashaishibe ukubelenga balepepa Tata Wesu 150, pa numa Mwapoleni Maria 150, ukulabipenda pa ntambo ya mpande: «Amalumbo ya kwa Maria».
By a beloved tradition, the Blessed Virg: Ukulingana ne ntambi iyitemwikwa, Maria Nacisungu apeele Rosari kuli Santu Dominiko ku Prouille, mu Fransi, ku ntendekelo ya myanda ya myaka iya 13, pa kuti imwafwe mu kushimikila kwakwe ukulwisha ifisambilisho fya bufi ifya Ba-albigensi. Ibumba lyakwe, Ibumba lya Bashimikishi, lyaisalanganya mu Bwina Kristu bonse, kabili mu myanda ya myaka iya 15 Uwapaalwa Alano wa La Roche, umuDominikani, alengele ukupepa uku ukuba kupya kabili atendeke amabumba ya kubalilapo aya Rosari.
Pope Saint Pius V, himself a Dominican,: Santu Papa Pio V, na wene umuDominikani, apeele Rosari imipangilwe yaiko iya lyonse iya nkama ikumi na shisano, isha Nsansa, isha Bulanda ne sha Bukata, mu 1569. Pa numa ya kucimfya kwa ku Lepanto pa 7 Oktoba 1571, ukwasangilwe ilyo Ubwina Kristu bonse bwalepepa Rosari, alengele ubo bushiku ukuba umutebeto wa kwa Maria wa Kucimfya, nomba icibukisho ca kwa Maria Nacisungu wa Rosari. Ku Lourdes na ku Fatima, Nacisungu wine aishile na rosari kabili alombele ukuti ilepepwa cila bushiku.
On October 16, 2002, Pope Saint John Pau: Pa 16 Oktoba 2002, Santu Papa Yohane Paulo II alundilepo inkama shisano isha Lubuuto, ukufuma ku mweo wa kwa Shikulu wesu pa lwalala, mu kalata wakwe uwa butumwa Rosarium Virginis Mariae, pa kuti Rosari ibe «ica kufupikisha Landwe Lusuma». Muli cila nkama tutontonkanya pa cinso ca kwa Kristu ukulolesha ne menso ya kwa Nyina.
